text: There is a breakpoint before the square function as shown. When labview paused execution at the breakpoint what will happen if you press the (step into) button?
options: Labview will highlight the square function but will not execute it
Labview will open up the block diagram of the square function to allow you to single step through the code inside the square function
Labview will open up the square function and then highlight the next node to be executed as you continue single-stepping through the VI
Labview will complete the execution of the VI and return  to the calling VI(if one exit)
